job: Open a top-level screen with a tall title band and one line about it.
purpose: A tall title band for the screens people reach from the sidebar: an eyebrow, the screen name, one line of what it is for, and an art slot that fades toward the text and holds an ASCII texture. Page-wide actions go in fd-page-hero-actions at the end of the title row (at most one primary) and drop under the line when there is no room.
useWhen: A top-level screen, such as Monitoring or Settings, opens a section of the product.
The page has an action for the whole page: connect, get the code, export everything.

avoidWhen.when: A working page under a section, where space matters.
A create button that belongs to one list.
A single task outside the shell.

parts.role: Wraps the eyebrow, title and line so the actions can sit beside them.
The slot for a texture field; it fills this box.
